A whitespace-only subscript keeps the word separator

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>A<sub> </sub>B</p>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
